Try a 20‑minute garlic‑lime chicken stir‑fry: slice 2 chicken breasts, toss with 1 tbsp oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, zest and juice of 1 lime, salt, pepper. Stir‑fry 5‑6 min, add sliced bell pepper and snap peas, cook 3 min more. Serve over quick‑cook rice or noodles, garnish with cilantro.

PLAN: Gather chicken, garlic, lime, veggies, oil, rice.
PLAN: Slice chicken, mince garlic, zest lime, chop veggies.
PLAN: Stir‑fry, then serve over rice.
